Statistics Canada Crop Production Summary - Sep 16

WINNIPEG--The following is a quick summary of the 
Statistics Canada September model-based principal field crop 
production estimates for 2026-27. 
     Previous numbers and the five-year average are included for 
comparison. Production in million metric tonnes. Source: 
Statistics Canada. 
 
            2026-27   2025-26    5-year 
                SEP             Average 
Durum         6.417     7.305     5.351 
All wheat    36.122    40.562    33.443 
Oats          3.031     3.920     3.609 
Barley        9.713     9.725     8.749 
Canola       22.051    22.227    18.806 
Flaxseed      0.386     0.454     0.360 
Peas          3.260     3.934     3.041 
Lentils       2.467     3.363     2.304 
Corn         16.549    14.867    14.957 
Soybeans      7.456     6.918     6.890 
 
Source: Glacier FarmMedia, philfw@farmmedia.com
